in_hebrew.name: אוגוסטינה
in_hebrew.meaning: בעלת כושר ועוצמה, נשים עם שם זה בכנסייה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוגוסטינה היא שם נשים שמקורו בשם הלטיני 'אוגוסטינוס', שהועבר דרך היוונית, 'אוגוסטוס', שפירושו 'הגדול' או 'העצום'. שם זה קשור למסורת נוצרית, ואחד האבות הקדושים המפורסמים ביותר שקיבל שם זה הוא אוגוסטינוס הקדוש, שהיה בישוף ותאולוג חשוב. שם 'אוגוסטינה' נחשב לראוי לנשים שמעוניינות בסמל מעצים וחזק, אבל גם שמח, חכמה ואמינית.

in_greek.name: Αὐγουστίνα
in_greek.meaning: שם שמציין כושר, עוצמה, חכמה, ואמינות
in_greek.long_meaning: Αὐγουστίνα הוא שם נשים שמקורו בשם הלטיני 'Αὐγουστῖνος', שהועבר דרך היוונית 'Αὐγούστος', שפירושו 'Ο μέγας', 'Ο τρεμλός'. שם Αὐγουστίνα קשור למסורת Χριστιανική, και αένας απο τους άγιους Πατέρες, ο οποίος έλαβε αυτό το όνομα ήταν ο Αύγουστίνος ο Μέγας. το όνομα Αὐγουστίνα θεωρείται κατάλληλο για γυναίκες που θέλουν να εκπροσωπούν δύναμη, σοφία, και αισχροκέρδεια.

in_latin.name: Augustina
in_latin.meaning: שם שמציין כושר, עוצמה, חכמה, ואמינות
in_latin.long_meaning: Augustina, nomen femininum, originibus a nomine Augustino trahitur. Augustinus, nomen virile, a nomine Augustus, quod significat 'Magnus' aut 'Tremulus', trahitur. Augustina, nomen femininum, in ecclesia Christiana, nomen mulierum, qui potentiam, sapientiam, et fidem, repraesentari volunt. Augustinus, nomen virile, in ecclesia Christiana, nomen virorum, qui potentiam, sapientiam, et fidem, repraesentari volunt.

in_english.name: Augustina
in_english.meaning: woman with power, strength, wisdom, and faith, name associated with Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Augustina is a female given name with origins from the Latin name Augustinus, which is derived from the Latin name Augustus, meaning 'great' or 'powerful'. The name Augustina is associated with Christian tradition and is considered suitable for women who wish to represent power, wisdom, and faith. The name Augustina has its roots in the Latin name Augustinus, which was borne by one of the most influential Christian fathers, Saint Augustine, a bishop and theologian. Augustina is also associated with Saint Augustine of Hippo, a prominent Christian saint. In modern times, the name Augustina has gained popularity as a symbol of strength, wisdom, and faith, making it a popular choice for Christian parents.

data.cultural_impact: The name Augustina has been popular in Western societies due to the influence of two significant figures: St. Augustine of Hippo (AD 354-430) and St. Augustine of Rome (3rd-4th century AD). St. Augustine of Hippo, also known as Augustine of Hippo or Saint Augustine, was a influential, early Christian philosopher, theologian, and writer whose thoughts influenced the development of Western Christianity and philosophy. His works are among the most important sources of information about Western Christian theology. In contrast, St. Augustine of Rome was a highly revered and venerated saint who was known for her great faith and devotion to God. Both saints' legacies have contributed to the spread and popularity of the name Augustina in Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Augustina is rooted in the Latin word 'augustus', which signifies 'majestic', 'exalted', or 'noble'. This name holds deep spiritual significance for Christians as it represents the virtues of humility, exalted faith, and devotion to God. In the Christian tradition, the name Augustina can symbolize the exalted nature of one's faith, belief, and trust in God, which transcends the material world and connects one to the divine. It is a reminder of the awed reverence and appreciation for the spiritual journey and the ultimate goal of experiencing the divine presence.

historical_references.reference: Saint Augustine of Hippo was a renowned philosopher, theologian, and writer in the Western Christianity tradition. He is best known for his Confessions, a spiritual autobiography.
Augustine's works, particularly his City of God, greatly influenced the development of Western Christianity and Western philosophy.

trends: Augustine's works are still studied in philosophy and theology classes
